entities.name: Davriel Cane
entities.description: A planeswalker who enjoys wealth, luxury and fine tea and is a talented diabolist skilled at binding demons to his service.

events.summary: Davriel often finds himself in the hero's role despite detesting it and trying to avoid it.
events.quote: He detests playing the hero, yet often finds himself in the role despite his best efforts to avoid it.
